segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Hi, how are you?
I am fine. How are you?
I am also fine.
What are you doing?
Nothing much, just doing some work on the phone.
Oh, okay.
What are you doing?
What did you say?
I am just doing some work.
I am doing my B.Com final year, and also doing a part-time job.
Okay, what's the news?
I should be the one asking you. How is everything going? Is work okay?
Work is fine.
How is life?
It's not bad, it's going on in its own way.
What do you do in your free time?
Nothing much, I just look after the garden.
Apart from work, it's just the garden.
If I go to the garden one day, I don't have anything else to do.
What about friends?
Friends are there, but I don't feel like meeting anyone right now.
Are they school or college friends? Or childhood friends?
Childhood friends.
Don't you meet them now?
After the breakup, I don't feel like going anywhere.
Are you alone right now? Is everyone at home with you, or is the garden somewhere else?
Mom and dad are downstairs. I am talking from upstairs.
Okay.
What else is new?
I should be asking you.
What is it? If you tell me about your college stories, I will listen.
College? How many years has it been since you finished college?
It's been 10 years since I left college.
College doesn't change much, but life is fun.
Everyone feels like they should study in college, thinking about how it should be.
It's good, it's going well for now.
What about you? Do you have a girlfriend in college?
I had one from high school.
From high school?
Was it a crush or a serious love?
Serious love. It ended because of me.
You had a serious love in high school?
Yes, a crush in high school, but in the first year of PUC, it became a confirmed love.
Okay, and in the second year of PUC, she got married.
Oh, that's sad.
It was my fault.
I felt bad.
No, it was my fault. Because of my mistake, they got her married.
Did your family know about it?
I hadn't gone to college for a week. In that time, you know how college life is. We were like crazy people.
I went to her house.
Her parents had gone to work.
Okay.
It was a bit of an adventure.
In that time, meeting secretly was fun.
Talking to her was a happy feeling.
You were brave to go to her house, that's why I asked.
She used to go to her house, but from high school, she used to go with me.
Okay.
After that, it was a bit of an adventure.
After that, was there any other love?
There was an online love.
So, I learned not to fall in love with anyone online.
Online love?
The heart doesn't know what it's doing.
Online, like on Telegram?
Okay, okay. Contact, okay.
We met on Telegram.
We were in a group, like a Telugu chat group.
We used to sit in the evening and chat.
We both got to know each other.
Where are you from?
Bangalore.
She is from Bagalkot, near Chikballapur.
Oh, Chikballapur, okay.
It's 30 kilometers from Chikballapur.
I used to go there every week just to see her.
Just to see her face.
Love is like that, right? Seeing her and talking to her.
When we were in college, we had a lot of time.
You missed it, that's all.
If you had said 10 years ago, we could have met at many spots.
We used to meet in college. Friends used to support us.
There was no problem.
Okay, okay.
Our friends and her friends, everyone supported us.
We were in love, and no one knew about it because we were doing group study.
No one suspected us.
All friends were together.
Okay.
But in that time, I don't know, I slipped a bit, and that was a mistake.
Nothing can be done, every life is like that. That stage is like that.
But if you had done it correctly, it would have been good.
It would have been good, I think.
Are you married now?
No, I am single for now.
That's first love.
I already had two breakups.
If I get serious again or get married, in this day and age, marriage is scary.
They will put you in a cooker or a drum, it's scary.
That depends on you.
That's why I don't want it. Another fear is arranged marriage.
Some people don't tell their family anything.
They just stay quiet.
Someone who has loved before will have the feeling that we are getting married.
Some people are like that, I won't say everyone.
But I have a fear.
Not everyone is like that.
Nowadays, people are very bold.
Back then, it wasn't like that.
They are there, but it depends on the caste or something.
Some people are scared.
Parents are also very direct in asking.
Before this, did you like anyone? Is it like that?
Everything is very forward now. It's a bit difficult for you, 10 years ago it was difficult.
But that girl also finished her second PUC, so I understand.
They got her married to someone else.
Oh, did they give her to a relative or someone else?
A relative.
They saw her at their neighbor's house and gave her to them.
After that, I didn't go to ask about this.
They got her married in a week. I got to know after she got married.
Didn't you know she didn't come for a week? Didn't she come to college?
No, I went to see her, but she wasn't there.
There was a little romance, but we came back happily.
How did you contact her? Did you have a phone?
No phone.
There was a week's gap, right?
She had friends, and from college, no one used to come from her neighborhood.
People used to come from her place, but this matter, she didn't tell anyone except her house.
Now, if it's the same college, were there no friends?
They said she wasn't well and her grandmother took her home.
Oh, they did everything in a week.
After that, I shouldn't have gone to her house.
I can't forget it now.
We met three or four times, but that feeling is always there.
Now that girl has three kids.
What do they say?
We feel very bad.
She also struggled a lot.
Yes, it must have been difficult.
In high school, we both liked each other but didn't tell anyone.
After going to college, we got a bit brave and proposed.
It was okay, but then it ended.
What else is new?
I should be asking you.
Tell me, let's listen.
I am just boring you with my stories.
Nothing is boring in love.
But if you remember it, you can tell me.
You really loved her, that's why you feel like crying.
Why did that day happen? Why did it move forward?
That's true.
God must have written it like that. It had to end that day.
It's not in our hands, what has to happen will happen.
When we love, we meet secretly. If we touch her, we feel like we are flying in the air.
Can you imagine your life now?
I shouldn't have gone that day. After a year, I would have married her.
Happy life.
I told you about the online love, right? I told her everything.
We fell in love after that.
Finally, she said she understood my love from your words.
I have been in love for three months, and I love her so much.
She has been loving me since she was a child.
She is very strong.
In this day and age, there is no value for genuine love.
In this day and age, only sex has value.
Sorry.
In every age, love has value. It depends on the girl or boy, I won't say it's wrong.
In this generation, the environment in which they grow up matters.
Don't take too much tension. I can't explain it, but I understand.
That pain is lifelong, they have given it.
What to do next? Don't get married?
For now, I don't want to get married, I am just quiet.
Pressure is there, I am 29 now.
My younger brother is my cousin, there is a two-month difference.
He got married and has two kids.
When I go home, they say don't do this, and they are all gone.
One day a week, it's compulsory.
One day a week, they keep scolding me about this.
Are you the only son?
Three daughters and one son. My sister is married, I am the only one left.
If you want to cook something, just bring your wife and get it done.
I am old enough, get married soon, they say.
What is the guarantee that the person who comes will cook?
Whether they do it or not, if she doesn't, I will do it.
First, you get married, they say.
I am tired of hearing all this, so I just keep quiet.
What does your girlfriend say if you ask her about this?
About what?
About getting married.
Did you ask her? Will you get married or not?
Who? The girl I loved?
Yes, her. She won't ask you? Why are you alone? You should get married, right?
I am already married, nothing can be done, she said something like that.
Then, about the online love I told you about, we are talking after the breakup.
But it won't go that way.
We are just talking as friends.
She is getting married on the 20th or 24th.
Does it become a friend after love?
It doesn't happen, but the feeling in the heart remains the same.
Whatever you do, you can just say she is a friend in front of others.
But the feeling is there in the heart. So, I don't go there or talk much.
Hi means hi, bye means bye, that's it.
I have to see her status, and when I see it, I feel bad.
You are remembering her a lot, that's why.
What do you like apart from this?
Nothing else. I am doing the work I have now.
I want to start a dairy farm.
I want to put 50 cows.
For that, I don't have enough capital.
For now, I want to do a small sheep farm, put 50-100 sheep.
Sheep and goats, put 50-50, improve it, and then do dairy.
Okay.
I don't feel like working for others.
You have to concentrate on that, right?
If I go for a loan, everything is on my name.
First, I have to get married, then I will give my life.
That's why...
You tell her clearly. No, I will get married only if I do this business, you put a condition.
Before this, I had an issue with a friend.
I gave her money and went to jail.
She left the town and went away.
You can't trust anyone these days.
That's why my family says, first get married.
After you get married, one month is enough. If you go to work, one month is enough.
Get married and go to work for a month.
From the second month, you can stay at home, I will do whatever you need, they say.
That's why I am quiet.
I want to do something on my own, especially a dairy farm.
Hello.
Hello.
Tell me.
Voice break happened.
Sorry.
I like it, but I have to do it, I will do it.
Do you like to study?
Do you like to study in the future?
Degree is done.
Start it, it will be good.
I went through a breakup.
I joined a job and after 3-4 years, I completed my degree.
Are you regular or correspondence?
Correspondence.
You want to work, right?
Life is like that.
In that time, it was good.
I can't hear you.
Voice is breaking. Can you hear my voice?
Yes, I can hear you, tell me.
I will increase the volume.
Can you hear me now?
Yes, I can hear you.
Tell me.
Did you have any plans before? Like studying, settling down, did you think of anything?
Before, it was different.
I wanted to study well and become a collector.
But I didn't know what to study at that time.
But I wanted to be a collector.
When I failed, I stopped studying.
I went home, and everyone was studying well, why am I like this?
In college, wherever I went, everyone was studying well, why am I like this?
So I cut off all my college friends.
I told you about my friends, I don't go with any of them.
The garden is done, are you alone now?
Yes, I am alone.
Work, finish work and come home, if not home, then the garden.
If I have to go, I go to the garden. If there is work, I do it in the garden.
I am just at home.
Are you bored?
I have had a cold for two days, it's increasing.
That's why.
This sadness is more about loneliness.
I don't want to go anywhere, I want to be alone.
Is it before marriage?
Even after marriage, people who understand us will come into our life, we can't say.
You have to understand yourself.
Do you want the same life? To understand you? Why don't you change your life?
Let anyone come, let the one who fights come, just keep fighting.
You say fight, but the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, husband, there is no luck in that.
If you stand on the mother's side, the wife won't like it.
If you go to the wife's side, the mother will be against you.
I didn't say that. Why do you think about the mother and her?
What to do, you two...
How can we both be? If there is a fight between us, it will go on.
I don't care about that.
But the one who comes should stay at our house.
They have been with me for so long, I can't leave them after marriage.
Let's look at our life and go.
If we go like that, our kids will have problems.
If they do what we did, we will feel the pain.
The girls think like that.
But the mistakes they make, their...
What?
The girls think like that, right? Now, leaving everything, my husband thinks like that, right? After marrying you...
What will you say to them?
They are... now you are adjusting in your house, right?
Yes.
Wait a minute. Before she trusts me, I have to take the responsibility of her self-respect.
That's all that is needed.
If there is a mistake, I will scold her.
If she is not wrong, I will stand by her and talk.
Because her self-respect is important to me, because she comes from another house to my house.
I can't say she came from another house.
She shouldn't be disrespected.
No one should disrespect her self-respect, I will look after that.
In the same way, she should look after my house, that's what I need.
That's all that is needed.
Small fights will come, we have to solve them at home.
If we fight and scream, it won't be good.
I see my friends, they are married.
Wherever they go, they have to ask and go, there are restrictions.
Why do you think your life is like that?
Yes, you don't go anywhere, right?
After marriage, 95% of boys' lives become like that.
Now, you go to someone who is married.
Ask them if their bachelor life was good or if their married life is good.
95% will say bachelor life was good.
Because after marriage, it's not just marriage, responsibility comes.
Is that so?
Before marriage, parents take responsibility. After marriage, your responsibilities join.
That responsibility... in this, the girls... the girls don't make mistakes, you know?
Boys don't take that responsibility from a young age.
Suddenly they take it, right? That's why they have fear, everything starts.
That's why they say, oh, my bachelor life was good, I was comfortable, no tension, mom used to cook, I used to eat.
If I threw it, she used to take it. After she came, everything is a headache, marriage is a headache, that's what boys say.
100% it's true.
But the reason is...
That's why I said it, boys.
Right?
Okay, leave it, it's done. Tell me your love story, let's listen.
My love story?
I think you have a love story. When you talk, I can tell it's a painful love story.
Hmm?
Hmm?

Tell me, tell me first.
